metadata.author: Hopscotch
metadata.description: The catchy educational songs you know and love for our younger friends. Sing and dance along to the colors, numbers, alphabet, and more! Kids will learn how to recognize and spell the names of primary and secondary colors, how to form numbers zero through nine (and spell their names, too!), the letters of the alphabet and what sounds they make, the components of a complete sentence, the days of the week, and the months of the year (including how many days are in each month)!
